This directory is an offline source dependency snapshot for review of a local
ER/NR band calculation. It is not a new official NEST or DIAMX distribution.

NEST source: https://github.com/NESTCollaboration/nest
  Included: 9 core translation units, the copied include tree, original
  LICENSE (Apache 2.0), CITATION.md, and original README.md.
  Copied from the current local nestmaster_full response tree. Its own git
  metadata was unavailable; exact file hashes define the delivered snapshot.
  Local wrapper/detector selection is documented in response/README.txt.

GCE-Math: https://github.com/kthohr/gcem
  Included: the locally used include tree, original LICENSE (Apache 2.0),
  NOTICE.txt, and original README.md. Upstream copyright notices are retained.
  No new online dependency resolution is performed by the package.

All copied files are unedited relative to the identified local input files.
That assertion does not imply equivalence to an unmodified official release.
The per-file copy receipt is response/source_copy_manifest.json.

Application files outside this directory are local review/reproduction code;
no license for that local code is invented or inferred by these notices.
